<script>
(function () {
  var username = 'Bea-Taylor';
  var repoNames = ['london_council_housing', 'nimby_nlp', 'planning_scraper'];

  var langColors = {
    'Python': '#3572A5',
    'R': '#198CE7',
    'JavaScript': '#f1e05a',
    'TypeScript': '#2b7489',
    'HTML': '#e34c26',
    'Jupyter Notebook': '#DA5B0B',
    'Shell': '#89e051'
  };

  // function formatName(name) {
  //   return name.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); });
  // }

  function buildCard(repo) {
    var langColor = langColors[repo.language] || '#739A1B';
    var lang = repo.language
      ? '<span><span class="repo-lang-dot" style="background:' + langColor + '"></span>' + repo.language + '</span>'
      : '';
    return '<a href="' + repo.html_url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="repo-card">'
      + '<h3>' + repo.name + '</h3>'
      + '<p>' + (repo.description || '') + '</p>'
      + '<div class="repo-meta">' + lang + '<span>&#9733; ' + repo.stargazers_count + '</span><span><i class="bi bi-share" style="font-size:0.85em"></i> ' + repo.forks_count + '</span></div>'
      + '</a>';
  }

  function loadRepos() {
    var container = document.getElementById('github-repos-container');
    if (!container) return;

    var promises = repoNames.map(function (name) {
      return fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/' + username + '/' + name)
        .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
        .catch(function () { return null; });
    });

    Promise.all(promises).then(function (results) {
      var valid = results.filter(Boolean);
      if (valid.length === 0) return;
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="repo-grid">' + valid.map(buildCard).join('') + '</div>';
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadRepos);
  } else {
    loadRepos();
  }
})();
</script>
